outlook:
What Rambus says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue to be between $227 million and $233 million. The Company also expects product revenue to be between $127 million and $133 million, royalties revenue to be between $68 million and $74 million, and contract and other revenue to be between $26 million and $32 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: earnings per shareAdditionally, the Company expects GAAP diluted earnings per share to be between $0.68 and $0.76 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share to be between $0.84 and $0.92.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
